shots.name: s01_look_at_this
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up of a vertical holographic phone feed floating in dark void. Three video cards stacked, each emitting yellow light. Bold yellow text overlay reads 'LOOK AT THIS' in the upper third. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, dramatic atmospheric lighting, photo-realistic 3D render, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Slow camera dolly-in toward the holographic phone feed. Yellow light pulses softly from the video cards. The LOOK AT THIS text remains crisp. Continuous gentle dramatic motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.subtitle: LOOK AT THIS

shots.name: s02_likes_pulse
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of yellow heart-shaped particles streaming up from a phone screen in dark space. The hearts trail glowing yellow energy. Particles converge into a luminous yellow stream flowing upward. Cyberpunk-tech atmospheric, photo-realistic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Yellow heart particles continuously emit from the phone screen. They flow upward in a rising stream. The energy intensifies. Continuous flowing motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Every like programs an AI agent.
shots.subtitle: Every like programs an AI agent

shots.name: s03_agent_picks
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of a sleek AI agent figure reaching out and grasping a glowing yellow code block from a holographic interface. Yellow energy crackles between agent's hand and the code block. Dark cyberpunk environment. Photo-realistic 3D render, dramatic shadows, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Agent's hand closes around the glowing code block. Yellow energy crackles continuously. The agent pulls the code block toward itself. Continuous purposeful motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: The agent picks up an issue.
shots.subtitle: Agent picks up an issue

shots.name: s04_pr_lands
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of a glowing green checkmark appearing on a futuristic holographic GitHub-style interface in dark space. Bold yellow text 'MERGED' visible. Yellow particles emanate from the checkmark. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, dramatic lighting, photo-realistic 3D render, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: The green checkmark fades in and pulses brightly. Yellow particles burst outward continuously. The MERGED text remains stable. Continuous celebratory motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: And ships a real pull request.
shots.subtitle: Ships a real PR

shots.name: s05_loop
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of a circular flowing loop made of yellow energy in dark space. The loop shows mini icons along its circumference: a heart, a code block, a checkmark, a video. Yellow particles flow along the loop continuously. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, atmospheric, photo-realistic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Yellow energy continuously flows around the loop. Particles travel along the loop's path. The icons pulse softly in sequence. Continuous rotational motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Likes become code. Code becomes the next video.
shots.subtitle: the loop closes

shots.name: s06_cta
shots.image_prompt: Hero shot of the bold yellow Rally R logo glowing in dark void. Yellow particles orbit. Text 'rallysignal.co' below. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, ultra-dramatic atmospheric lighting, photo-realistic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: The yellow R logo pulses with light. Yellow particles orbit slowly. Continuous gentle motion, hero ending shot, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Comment merge if you'd build this.
shots.subtitle: comment 'merge' to vote
